proposal.reason: Main change is CI workflow execution logic: .github/workflows/build-artifactory-ppu.yml adds authenticated registry login before docker pull, resolves t-head/pccl-tests from a branch paired to github ref with fallback to main, and pins source/test commits for timestamp labels via prepare outputs; .github/workflows/source-sanity.yml and pccl-daily-full.yml propagate that resolved revision/branch through checkout, cache probe/publish, and runner validation paths. Supporting .github/xtest/artifact_cache.py and test_workflow_contract.py only retag fixture runner metadata to match this CI contract, so no separate module is independently changed.
